name: Plink by Pokerist
detailed_description:
Play the legendary casino game of chance for free: Plink by Pokerist. Drop balls from the top of a pyramid and get huge winnings based on where they land.

Choose your risk level and prove you've got what it takes to become a Plink by Pokerist legend!

Immerse yourself in the Plink atmosphere, enjoy smooth animations, and win big!

◆ Game features ◆

FREE CHIPS – Play the game every day to get free chips!

CHOOSE YOUR RISK LEVEL — Configure Plink to your liking. Pick the pay table for each ball you drop. Choose higher chances of getting smaller prizes, or take a riskier path to pursue huge winnings!

IMMERSIVE ANIMATIONS — Our Plink balls change color based on how close they are to the ultimate payout. We've designed our game to replicate and improve the feel of high-stakes Plink machines, providing an immersive Plink by Pokerist experience that keeps you on the edge of your seat.

GET REWARDS — Place bets, take risks and unlock achievements.

QUESTS — Complete daily quests to get free chips!

YOUR OWN PROFILE PAGE — Track your progress and status in the game! Get experience and level up. See how many Plink by Pokerist games you've played and achievements you've completed. Get unique properties and display them on your profile. View other players' profiles to see how you compare!

FAIR PLAY GUARANTEED — Our certified Random Number Generator (RNG) gives you the best and fairest Plink by Pokerist experience!

NO REGISTRATION – Get straight into the action. Choose guest mode to use our free casino app without registering.

This game is only available to users of legal age. The game offers no possibility of winning money or anything of value. Success in playing this game does not imply your success in a similar real-money casino game.

Notice for players in Washington State

Due to legal restrictions in Washington State, this game is not available for players located in this region. We apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding."
